name: Leg Press
steps: Sit against the backrest and place both feet near the middle of the footplate, about shoulder-width apart.
Press the sled slightly upward to release the safety catches while keeping your knees softly unlocked.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the sled, stopping before your pelvis rolls off the pad.
Press through both feet to straighten your legs, then engage the catches before stepping off.
tips: Never lock your knees forcefully at the top of the press.
Stop the descent before your tailbone curls up off the seat pad to protect your lower back.
